subject: civics
question_text: Read and discuss the following description of the living conditions of workers who come to the labour chowk.
answer_text: Living condition of workers who came to the labour chowk: (i) Workers are living in the harsh condition and suffering from lack of basic facilities and security. (ii) The workers at labour chowk find out regular jobs but do not have permanent jobs. (iii) They do not have permanent shelter so sleep on pavements or in paid shelter of Municipal corporation. (iv) The protection of their money and tools are provided by the local tea and cigarettes shops in an unorganised manner. (v) Labourers also took loans from these shops.
final_answer: The workers at the labour chowk face harsh living conditions with no permanent shelter and lack of security.
difficulty_reasoning: Requires understanding of living conditions and basic analysis.

subject: civics
question_text: What benefits does Sudha get along with her salary?
answer_text: Sudha gets different benefits along with her salary: (i) Savings for old age: A part of her salary is kept in fund with government on which she gets interest and retirement. (ii) Holidays: She doesn't have to work on Sundays and national holidays. She also gets some annual leave. (iii) Medical facilities: She gets paid leave for illness and free treatment. Her family gets paid medical facilities up to a certain amount by the company. (iv) Job security: She also has a permanent job and security of it.
final_answer: Sudha receives various benefits including savings for old age, holidays, medical facilities, and job security.
difficulty_reasoning: Involves understanding of employee benefits and job security.
